support.title: Draft a safer reply
support.action: Use a fictional ticket to practise drafting a reply, then check its facts and tone.

support.title: Summarise before escalating
support.action: Summarise a redacted ticket thread and compare it with the source before escalating.

support.title: Build a review habit
support.action: Check every AI draft against your team's approved guidance before sending it.

engineering.title: Start with a small test
engineering.action: Ask an approved assistant for a unit test using synthetic data and run it locally.

engineering.title: Review every change
engineering.action: Check an AI suggestion line by line and verify it with a focused test.

engineering.title: Compare two approaches
engineering.action: Ask for two solutions to a small coding problem and explain their tradeoffs yourself.

sales.title: Practise an outreach draft
sales.action: Draft an email for a fictional prospect and edit its claims before using the structure.

sales.title: Check your summaries
sales.action: Compare an AI summary of synthetic call notes against the original notes.

sales.title: Make a reusable checklist
sales.action: Write a checklist for checking tone, accuracy and private details in AI drafts.

manager.title: Choose one workflow
manager.action: Pick one low-risk task and measure time saved after reviewing its AI output.

manager.title: Review approved guidance
manager.action: Read your team's AI policy and clarify any uncertain data-sharing rules.

manager.title: Plan a small experiment
manager.action: Try an approved tool with synthetic data and record one benefit and one limitation.

data_risk.title: Use synthetic examples
data_risk.action: Practise your next AI task with fictional details instead of real customer information.

data_risk.title: Check the policy
data_risk.action: Confirm which tools and data types your organization permits before your next prompt.

data_risk.title: Verify before using
data_risk.action: Compare every important AI claim against an approved source before acting on it.
